lines.text: Paul says elders who lead well deserve double honor, and he quotes Scripture about not muzzling an ox treading grain.
Paul tells Timothy to accept an accusation against an elder only on two or three witnesses, and to rebuke persistent sin privately.

wrong_details.true: those who persist in sin should be rebuked in front of everyone

lines.text: Paul solemnly charges Timothy to act without partiality and not to be too quick in the laying on of hands.
Paul tells Timothy to use a little wine because of his stomach, and says sins and good deeds may surface later.
Paul says slaves should honor their masters so God's name is not discredited, and serve believing masters because they are elders.
